providers.title: Contractive homomorphisms
providers.scope: A unital homomorphism of a unital C*-algebra into B(H) of norm at most 1 is a *-homomorphism.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Unitary absorption
providers.scope: Representations similar through an invertible V are unitarily equivalent through V|V|^-1, and |V| commutes with the first representation.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Paulsen's similarity theorem
providers.scope: A unital homomorphism is similar to a *-homomorphism iff it is completely bounded; the least condition number of a similarity is ||pi||_cb, attained by a positive similarity.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Triangular homomorphisms
providers.scope: [[lambda, c Delta],[0, sigma]] is a unital homomorphism with norm at most beta(c||Delta||) and cb norm at most beta(c||Delta||_cb).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Implementation of derivations
providers.scope: A completely bounded rectangular derivation is implemented by an operator of norm at most ||Delta||_cb / 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Christensen's criterion
providers.scope: A rectangular derivation is implemented by a bounded operator iff it is completely bounded.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Arveson's distance formula
providers.scope: For a C*-algebra A in B(H) containing 1 and x in B(H), 2 dist(x, A') = ||ad(x)|_A||_cb, and the distance is attained.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Noncommutative little Grothendieck inequality (Haagerup)
providers.scope: For T: A -> H bounded there are states f, g with ||Tx||^2 <= ||T||^2 (f(x*x) + g(xx*)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Row and column estimate (Christensen; Dickson)
providers.scope: Every bounded unital homomorphism of a unital C*-algebra satisfies ||phi||_row, ||phi||_col <= sqrt2 ||phi||^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rows and columns of derivations
providers.scope: Bounded rectangular derivations satisfy ||Delta||_row, ||Delta||_col <= 4 sqrt2 ||Delta||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Finite cyclic sets
providers.scope: A bounded unital homomorphism with a cyclic set of m vectors satisfies ||pi||_cb <= m ||pi||_row ||pi||_col <= 2m ||pi||^4.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Haagerup's cyclic similarity theorem
providers.scope: Such a homomorphism is similar to a *-homomorphism with condition number at most 2m ||pi||^4.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Column factorization
providers.scope: In a von Neumann algebra with a cyclic vector every unit vector of K^h is v zeta with v a contractive column over the algebra and zeta a unit vector.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Implementation on a cyclic domain
providers.scope: A bounded rectangular derivation whose domain representation is cyclic has ||Delta||_cb <= 8 sqrt2 ||Delta|| and is implemented by an operator of norm at most 4 sqrt2 ||Delta||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exponential form of a similarity
providers.scope: A similarity of the identity representation is a unitary conjugate of x -> e^-t x e^t with ||r||_cb = ||e^t|| ||e^-t||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Three-lines bound
providers.scope: For t self-adjoint and a unitary, ||ta - at|| <= log max(||e^-t a e^t||, ||e^-t a* e^t||).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Integral formula
providers.scope: If ||r_t||_cb = ||e^t|| ||e^-t||, then log ||r_t||_cb <= ||delta_t||_cb.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Kirchberg's lemma
providers.scope: If ||delta_t||_cb <= k ||delta_t|| for all self-adjoint t, then every similarity r of the identity representation satisfies ||r||_cb <= ||r||^(2k).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Similarity from inner derivations
providers.scope: A uniform bound ||Delta_t||_cb <= k ||Delta_t|| for inner derivations in all representations gives ||pi||_cb <= ||pi||^(2k) for all bounded unital homomorphisms.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Inner products of words
providers.scope: Centred alternating words of different types are orthogonal; for equal types the inner product is the product of the letterwise inner products.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Word decomposition
providers.scope: L^2 of the algebra generated by two free subalgebras is the direct sum of the tensor products of their centred L^2 spaces over alternating types.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Left multiplication
providers.scope: Left multiplication by Q_1 acts on the first factor of L^2(Q_1) (x) F_1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Conditional expectations
providers.scope: The expectation onto Q_1 kills words containing a Q_2 letter, and agrees with the expectation onto Q_1' on W*(Q_1', Q_2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Letterwise automorphisms
providers.scope: Trace-preserving automorphisms of the two free algebras extend to a trace-preserving automorphism implemented letter by letter.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Conjugation by a free Haar unitary
providers.scope: If W*(u) is free from P for a Haar unitary u, then u B u* is free from P for every subalgebra B of P.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free corner estimate (OpenAI, 2026)
providers.scope: An operator commuting with L_D whose commutators with a corner e L e of trace 1/N are at most eps almost commutes with trace-zero symmetries of A_0 on L^2(A_0), with constant 3 pi^2 (1 + 16 sqrt2); proof completed in the Hankel test lesson.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Factoriality
providers.scope: D' cap L = C1, so L is a II_1 factor.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Symmetrization
providers.scope: One may assume G commutes with the letterwise automorphisms induced by the matrix unitaries.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Schur-Weyl for unitary groups
providers.scope: Operators commuting with all u^(x)p are combinations of permutations, independent when m >= p.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Invariant multilinear forms
providers.scope: Unitarily invariant multilinear forms on M_m^p are unique combinations of cycle-trace forms when m >= p.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Invariant intertwiners
providers.scope: A bounded operator between word levels intertwining L_D and the matrix conjugations vanishes between different levels and is I (x) sum a_sigma U_sigma on equal levels.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Word structure
providers.scope: The symmetrized G preserves word levels and acts on repeated-letter tensors only through operators B_k on the A_0 letters.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Full columns from a small corner
providers.scope: On vectors with right support of trace at most t, G agrees up to c_0 eps with a right multiplication.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Propagation
providers.scope: ||B_k(s^(x)k (x) v) - s^(x)k (x) B_0 v|| <= 2 c_0 eps ||v||_2 for every k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Compressed commutator
providers.scope: On the copies U_k L^2(A_0), ||[I (x) B_0, i* L_h i]|| <= (1 + 4 c_0) eps ||h|| for h in e L e.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The dihedral corner
providers.scope: w = ds is a Haar unitary, p C p is spanned densely by the p w^l p, and pDp, pCp are free.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Even functions of w
providers.scope: Trace formulas for g(c) w^l and g(c) w^l d with c = Re w.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free compression
providers.scope: E_C(ebe) = u^2 b and ||ebe|| <= 2 sqrt(u) ||b||_2 + u ||b|| for centred self-adjoint b in pCp.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Toeplitz and Hankel coefficients
providers.scope: The compression of L_h to the copies is u (T_g (x) I + H_g (x) L_s), so the commutator with I (x) B_0 is u H_g (x) [B_0, L_s].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Irreducible matrix subfactors (Popa)
providers.scope: A II_1 factor with separable predual contains an irreducible subfactor generated by increasing full matrix algebras.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free position
providers.scope: For Q in P irreducible there is a Haar unitary u in Q^omega free from P, and u Q u* is free from P.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Finite standard multiplicities
providers.scope: For a II_1 factor with separable predual on finitely many copies of L^2(M), ||[Y^(h), X]|| <= (3 c_1 + 2) g_M(Y) ||X||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Factors
providers.scope: For a factor on a separable space, ||[Y^(h), X]|| <= C_fac g_P(Y) ||X||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Separable von Neumann algebras
providers.scope: For a von Neumann algebra on a separable space, ||[Y^(h), X]|| <= C g_P(Y) ||X||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uniform commutator estimate (OpenAI, 2026)
providers.scope: For every von Neumann algebra P in B(K), Y in B(K) and X in M_h(P), ||[Y^(h), X]|| <= C g_P(Y) ||X|| with C < 6308.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Derivations are inner
providers.scope: Every bounded rectangular derivation of a unital C*-algebra has ||Delta||_cb <= C ||Delta|| and an implementing operator of norm at most C ||Delta|| / 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Kadison's similarity theorem (OpenAI, 2026)
providers.scope: Every bounded unital homomorphism pi of a unital C*-algebra satisfies ||pi||_cb <= ||pi||^(2C) and is similar to a *-homomorphism with condition number at most ||pi||^(2C).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Universal hyperreflexivity (OpenAI, 2026)
providers.scope: Every von Neumann algebra M in B(H) satisfies alpha_M(T) <= dist(T, M) <= 2C alpha_M(T).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
